_comment: Which model runs each phase. 'why' is printed in the report next to every decision. Edit freely: any model id from models.json, either provider.

plan.why: the spec and task list drive every later step; a planning mistake costs more than the planning call

design.why: art direction (palette, type, layout ideas) sets the look of every page; taste is worth the strongest model

easy.why: easy task: the cheapest model; the verifier catches mistakes and repair escalates

medium.why: normal feature work: Sonnet is the cost/quality sweet spot for code

hard.why: hard task (auth, complex state, multi-file wiring): strongest routed model

ui.why: design is non-negotiable (target 9/10): every UI task gets the strongest model

chain.why: cheap-first: most failures are small (import path, typo); tests decide if the fix worked
escalation: the cheap attempt did not pass verification
last resort: two cheaper attempts failed

review.why: a different model family reviews the code, so it catches mistakes the builder model is blind to

fix_review.why: apply reviewer findings: ordinary code edits, verified afterwards

visual_review.why: looks at real screenshots of the running app and scores the design like a senior product designer

design_fix.why: closing the gap to 9/10 takes taste: the strongest model fixes design, checking each change on live screenshots

learning._comment: After enough runs, a model whose verified success rate for a phase+difficulty falls below minSuccessRate is skipped for a stronger one.
